body:
"Clear checked" sits in the list screen's top controls, easy to tap by accident.
Move it into the list-properties screen — a red (danger) button between the
Category order and Notes sections — on both Android and web. The relocation makes
it deliberate; drop Android's clear-checked undo snackbar (properties has no
snackbar host, and the move + items-go-to-backlog recovery makes it unnecessary),
matching web which already has no clear-checked undo. Keep the "Clear checked (N)"
count label; only show it when there are checked items.
title: Move 'Clear checked' out of the list screen into list properties (too easy to hit accidentally)
